en: A vintage colorized postcard depicting a panoramic view of a riverside town with houses, docks, wooden structures, and ships in the water. The landscape is lush and surrounded by hills with a partly cloudy sky. The foreground has well-kept homes and gardens, and the background shows a bustling waterfront area. The upper left contains the printed title 'Skönsberg, Mon. Sundsvall.'
